description: Winner of the all-Ukrainian stage of the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025
summary:
ISM is an interactive 3D web platform that lets you explore the Moon in high definition and track space missions in real time.Designed like a modern mission control dashboard, it combines genuine satellite imagery from NASA and the Japanese space agency (JAXA) to give users a detailed, scientific view of the lunar surface and the surrounding space.
What You Can Do on the Platform:
Explore the Lunar Surface in High Resolution: Zoom smoothly from a global view of the Moon down to specific craters and landing sites. The map automatically switches between local NASA wide-angle imagery and high-definition JAXA terrain photos streamed directly from NASA Moon Trek and the USGS.
Control Sunlight and Shadows: Adjust how dark the night side of the Moon appears (from 0% to 100% shadow) and track the real-time position of the Sun and Earth to see how sunlight hits different craters and mountains.
Read Live Surface Data: Move your cursor anywhere over the Moon to instantly see the exact latitude, longitude,surface illumination, camera altitude, and map resolution (measured in meters per pixel).
Track Space Missions & Orbits: Switch between a surface view (LUNAR) and an orbital space view (CISLUNAR) to follow spacecraft trajectories, mission phases, and orbital telemetry around the Moon.

Lunar Surface Explorer — 3D Moon Telemetry
Lunar Surface Explorer is a web-based 3D lunar visualization and telemetry application. Its title indicates that the site is designed for exploring the Moon's surface in 3D and viewing lunar telemetry data.
